open_points.subject: Model M01 — Project alias mutation
open_points.text: its alias, a short neutral label the owner may give, the name the agent sees
open_points.question: Which product actions may first set, replace, or clear a Project alias: project creation, project correction, import, or some specified subset?
options: Creation, correction, and import may set or replace it, and correction may clear it
Only creation and import may set it; an existing alias cannot be changed or cleared
Import may set it, while ordinary creation and correction do not manage it
open_points.default_guess: Creation, correction, and import may set or replace the alias, and correction may clear it.

witness.initial: An active Project exists without an alias.
events: The owner submits a project correction that supplies an alias of at most 40 Unicode code points.
The agent subsequently reads the Project projection.
outcomes: Registry accepts the correction and the agent sees the new alias.
Project correction cannot change the alias, so the request is refused or the Project remains without one and the agent sees its id.

open_points.subject: Project alias disclosure class and kept snapshots
open_points.text: So an alias whose content breaks the rule does reach the agent and a consumer's kept snapshot (R0-82)
open_points.question: When an alias actually contains a person's name, an address, or another identifying value, does its field classification still permit it to reach the agent and remain in a consumer snapshot, or do R0-25, R0-26, and R0-80 prohibit those outcomes because the value is personal data?
options: Classification is determined solely by the alias field, so the value remains business_confidential and may reach the agent and a kept snapshot
Classification follows the actual value, so an identifying alias is personal_data and must not reach the agent or be kept by a consumer
open_points.default_guess: Apply the explicit R0-90 field-based rule: treat every alias as business_confidential despite its content.

witness.initial: An active Project has an alias of at most 40 characters that is exactly the customer's name or the object's address.
events: The agent reads the agent projection.
A consumer retains its permitted Project snapshot.
outcomes: R0-90 says the identifying alias reaches the agent and remains in the consumer's kept snapshot as business_confidential.
R0-25 and R0-26 say no personal-data value reaches the agent, while R0-80 says a personal value such as an address is read when used and not kept.
witness.observer: The agent, the consumer, and the data-protection auditor

open_points.subject: Model M01 — Project alias field
